pipelines.name: CI Manual

with.check_name: Test Results (${{ inputs.os }}, ${{ inputs.java-distribution }} ${{ inputs.java-version }}, ${{ inputs.test-profile }})

findings: [MEDIUM] ARTIFACT_CREDENTIAL_PERSISTENCE: Job 'test' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.

anti_patterns.message: Job 'test' runs actions/checkout without 'persist-credentials: false' and uploads build artifacts.
anti_patterns.remediation: Set 'with: persist-credentials: false' on actions/checkout steps in jobs that upload artifacts.

pipelines.name: Deploy
findings: [CRITICAL] NO_TEST_GATE: CRITICAL: Job 'deploy' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).

anti_patterns.message: CRITICAL: Job 'deploy' performs deployment without upstream test gates ('needs:' block is empty).
anti_patterns.remediation: Add a 'needs:' dependency on a test or verification job before executing deployment steps.

pipelines.name: Mark stale issues and close stale PRs

with.stale-issue-message: This issue is stale because it has been open 60 days with no activity. Remove stale label or comment if you think it's still relevant.
with.stale-pr-message: This PR is stale because it has been open 60 days with no activity. Remove stale label or comment or this will be closed in 5 days.

findings: [LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'stale' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
